author: TEDx Talks
description:
In this inspiring TEDx talk, Katherine Longhi addresses concerns about what many perceive as a backslide in equality and fairness in today’s world. Katherine explores the growing backlash against diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) initiatives in both corporate settings and society at large. Many see these challenges as threats to progress, but she reframes resistance not as a roadblock, but as a chance to innovate, educate, and strengthen commitment to positive change.

Through practical insights and a message of hope, Katherine shows how individuals and organisations can embrace DEI strategies, confront opposition constructively, and continue advancing equality, fairness, and inclusion. This talk is essential watching for anyone interested in workplace culture, diversity, inclusion, equity, and social progress, demonstrating that even in times of apparent regression, meaningful change is possible.
